correctness.rationale: Using the exact finite window g(j)=rho^j on Z_(qm), Fourier transform in the m modulation columns decomposes the Gabor synthesis into m q-by-q fibres. Writing t=ma+b gives fibre entries rho^((j-b) mod m) C_R[:,a+1_{b>j} mod q], R=rho^m, where C_R is invertible since its circular Fourier eigenvalues are (1-R^q)/(1-R exp(-2pi ik/q)). Thus rank equals the sum of distinct selected indices per fibre; full rank forces all remainders b_a equal, precisely the m coset masks. For each full-rank mask, diagonalization gives the full claimed lambda_(s,k), exact extrema, determinant and condition number. The derivative equation for optimal R is monotone and diverges at R->1, giving a unique global minimizing taper. Direct independent NumPy synthesis/SVD over all 20 q=3,m=2 masks at rho=.6 checked rank and exact squared spectrum; source checker covers more finite instances. Exact proof is all q,m>=2, not finite extrapolation. Verified Git tree and RESULT.md/check_geometric_masks.py blob identities.
